name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Nikola Minchev
part_text:
Belgian prosecutors asked the European Parliament to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Nikola Minchev, a Bulgarian member, so they could charge him with passive public bribery. The Parliament decided not to lift it. It found the request too vague and unclear, and the later answers from the prosecutors did not settle the doubts. The Parliament also suggested the case may look like political pursuit. So the criminal case cannot go ahead for now.

- Nothing changes yet: Minchev keeps his immunity, so Belgium cannot prosecute him.
- It affects Minchev and Belgian prosecutors handling the bribery case.
- Parliament tells Belgium and Minchev of the decision; Belgium could send a clearer request.
